narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of "Pairs of Linear Equations in Two Variables". In this chapter, we'll explore how mathematics helps us solve real-life problems involving two unknown quantities. Get ready to build a strong foundation for advanced mathematical concepts!
